website.note: Cardiovascular cell therapy pipeline — CardiAMP autologous and CardiALLO/PulmALLO allogeneic MSC platforms

pipeline.asset: CardiAMP Cell Therapy System (autologous bone marrow cells)
pipeline.modality: Autologous bone marrow-derived cell therapy delivered transendocardially via Helix catheter (FDA Breakthrough Device Designation)

indications.indication: Ischemic heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF) — confirmatory pivotal
indications.trial_design: Phase 3 multi-center, randomized, double-blinded, sham-controlled study of up to 250 patients with elevated NTproBNP at up to 40 US centers; primary endpoint Finkelstein-Schoenfeld composite of mortality, MACCE and quality of life
indications.trial_status: Recruiting — four sites activated, enrollment ongoing (per FY2025 10-K)
key_milestones: Pivotal CardiAMP HF (NCT02438306) primary completion Feb 2025; Q-Sub planned to FDA on approvability based on subgroup with elevated heart-stress biomarkers
PMDA clinical consultation in Japan scheduled to align on use of existing data for market release

indications.indication: Chronic myocardial ischemia (CMI) with refractory angina
indications.trial_design: Phase 3 multi-center, randomized, double-blinded, controlled study of up to 343 patients at up to 40 US sites; under separate FDA-approved IDE
indications.trial_status: Roll-in cohort completed (107s ETT increase, 82% reduction in angina episodes at 6 mo); randomized portion pending non-dilutive/partnering funding
key_milestones: Roll-in cohort primary results submitted for Euro PCR May 2026

pipeline.modality: Allogeneic mesenchymal stem cell therapy (off-the-shelf), transendocardial delivery
pipeline.license_origin: Internal (manufactured at Sunnyvale, CA cGMP facility)

indications.indication: Ischemic heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF)
indications.trial_design: 3+3 dose escalation roll-in cohort followed by 60-patient randomized double-blind controlled study; Finkelstein-Schoenfeld composite of mortality, MACCE and 6MWD
indications.trial_status: Active, not recruiting — low-dose 20M cell cohort completed with no treatment-emergent AEs; DSMB recommended proceed

indications.trial_design: FDA-approved IND for IV allogeneic MSC in ARDS (originally COVID-19-related)
indications.trial_status: Withdrawn on ctgov; per 10-K no 2026 milestones set, awaiting partner funding

excluded_preclinical: Helix biotherapeutic delivery system and Morph access products (commercial/cleared devices, not clinical-stage assets)
excluded_legacy_terminated: CardiAMP HF Phase 3 pivotal (NCT02438306) — completed; new confirmatory CardiAMP HF II is the active pivotal
Earlier Phase 1/2 transendocardial autologous bone marrow studies (NCT00507468) — completed
